name: Red Light
source:
April 23, 2000

"Red Light" is a short horror story that follows Edgar, a victim of the Sun cult. The narrative delves into his internal struggles amidst the unfolding of strange events within the confines of the room where he is held captive.

[From [url=https://martyrvn.itch.io/red-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2000年4月23日《红灯》是一个简短的恐怖故事，讲述了太阳教受害者埃德加的故事。故事深入探讨了他在被囚禁的房间内发生的奇怪事件中的内心挣扎。
